review.ov8856: Apply upstream power/metadata changes; keep explicit Nabu xvclk acquisition/rate setup.
review.camss-vfe-17x: IRQ buffer-done gate fix already present. Retain Nabu one-to-one WM allocation and output path; upstream vfe_get_output_v2 implementation is absent in this fork.
review.camss-resources: Upstream changes SA8775P resources that are absent from this Nabu CAMSS fork; no resource block imported.
review.iris: Add IOVA state alongside Nabu LLCC state, fix clock/domain power-off order, and retain legacy-VPU5 guard before bridge reset writes.
review.fastrpc: Apply reserved-heap lifetime and error-cleanup fixes while retaining physical-address reporting and Nabu SNS/PDR attach helpers.
review.charger: qcom_smbx.c is absent; Nabu retains its own SMB5/BMS driver. No new charging calibration or driver replacement.
review.q6asm: Upstream fixes period-index wrap/underflow; Nabu already wraps a byte IRQ position and converts to frames. Retain that implementation.
review.iris-pm: Balance VPU5 clocks/domains/OPP across secure power collapse; retain shared queues/firmware/sessions and restore LLCC. Block commands while PM-off, serialize init/deinit and drain full teardown IRQs outside core mutex. Failed cores remain ERROR until teardown. No automatic reset-on-open or s2idle-only skip imported.
review.iris-opp-zero: Zero must call dev_pm_opp_set_opp(dev, NULL), releasing performance votes; inherited devfreq ceil lookup selected minimum OPP. Positive rates still use the recommended OPP; release/lookup errors propagate.

promotion: Experimental HW-08 debug6 revision 2. The first complete build is retained but superseded before staging by a zero-OPP release correction. Incremental build reuses its completed work volume. No tablet validation or promotion yet.

review_references.scope: Reviewed reference for independent power ownership / duplicate power-off protection; adapted to existing 7.3.4 unwind paths. Whole overlay and automatic recovery are not imported.
